_about: What's new: HIDDEN WHILE THIS LIST IS EMPTY (owner, Nov 2026: the site is launching and nobody needs to hear what changed). Every entry point (the avatar menu row, the dashboard button and its New badge) renders only when `entries` holds at least one entry, so posting one makes them all appear with no code change. When the owner asks for one: the RELEASED changes a member would notice, newest first, in plain words (src/ui/changelog.js draws them in a drawer). `id` is written into the device prefs blob (fms_studio_prefs_v1 `whatsNewSeen`) as the newest entry the reader has opened, so never reuse or rename one; add new entries at the TOP with a fresh id. Shape: {id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, items[]}.
